title: 50-Minute Driving Tour: Explore Hollywood in a Cybertruck
includes: 1 guide (who will either drive or be your copilot)
50 minute new Tesla Cyber Truck ride in Hollywood
Stop for pictures at Hollywood Sign
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Be among the first to experience the Tesla Cybertruck, one of the world's most talked-about vehicles, on an unforgettable sightseeing adventure through Hollywood. Begin your journey near the iconic Hollywood Walk of Fame before enjoying a thrilling ride through the city with fast-lane access and a scenic drive to Lake Hollywood Park, where you'll stop for incredible views of the Hollywood Sign and the Los Angeles skyline. This 50-minute guided experience combines cutting-edge innovation with one of LA's most iconic photo opportunities, making it the perfect tour for car enthusiasts, first-time visitors, and anyone looking for a truly unique Hollywood experience.
